newsitem.title: USA: Principal Financial 1996 net income up 52 pct.
newsitem.headline: Principal Financial 1996 net income up 52 pct.

text.p: Principal Financial Group said 1996 net income rose 52.7 percent to $526 million, largely due to investment and realized capital gains.
Operating earnings were $308.8 million, up 17.4 percent from the previous year. Total revenue in 1996 was $9.1 billion.
Principal Financial's Principal Mutual Life Insurance Co is the eighth largest U.S. life insurance company in assets.
Surplus reached $3.8 billion in 1996, a 16 percent increase over 1995. Assets under management grew 11 percent to $63.2 billion.
The company said membership in its HMOs grew 19 percent to 715,000.
In its life insurance and annuities business, total customer receipts rose 3.1 percent to $1.7 billion and variable annuity sales more than tripled.
